title: 394 Western Lake Drive Vacation Rental
meta_description: 394 Western Lake Drive is a 4.00 bedroom, 5.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:- WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pool Passes Included in Rental (Maximum Allotted Wristband Qty is 10) - One Block from WaterColor Shops and Restaurants- Located in the Heart of WaterColor's Park District- 4 Minute Stroll to WaterColor Boathouse Pool- 4 Adult Bikes Included in Rental- Natural Gas Grill- Carriage House- Parking For 2 Vehicles- 5 Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor- 3 Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club Access- 5 Minute Bike Ride to Seaside DETAILS:Welcome to a strikingly contemporary home that is elegantly adorned with a minimalist décor, which radiates an enduring sense of tranquility and refined elegance. Bask in the expansive room that features an abundance of comfortable seating arrangements providing an inviting space that is perfect for intimate gatherings or for simply unwinding after a long, exhilarating day on the sandy beaches. The heart of the house, the kitchen, is a culinary enthusiast's dream come true, boasting the latest in stainless steel appliances. It embodies a harmonious blend of function and form, equipped with extra bar seating that sets the stage for casual conversations over a freshly brewed cup of coffee or a quick, delightful snack. The dwelling features four generously spacious bedrooms, in addition to a carriage house, and is accompanied by five and a half bathrooms. Each room and facility within the house has been meticulously designed with both comfort and style in mind, ensuring a luxurious experience for all guests. Perfectly nestled in the serene Park District of WaterColor, this home provides uncomplicated access to the best the area has to offer. Whether your preference lies in a leisurely bike ride to the exclusive beach club, engaging in an array of fun-filled activities at the lively Camp WaterColor, or exploring the captivating natural beauty of WaterColor’s Boathouse, the location of this home ensures you're never more than a few moments away from your next thrilling adventure. Plan your next unforgettable beach vacation with Sanders Beach Rentals today. * Please note, indoor fireplace is not available for guest use. FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Laundry Area- Half Bathroom SECOND FLOOR:- Master Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (2), Shared Bathroom with Shower/ Tub Combo CARRIAGE HOUSE:- Two Twin Pull Out Sleeper Footstools (2), Private Bathroom with Walk In Shower PLEASE NOTE: Electric cart rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 60 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.
